items.title: ラッコ冒険オープンワールド『Otterly Lost』ラッコがかわいすぎて“好評率100%”スタート。遠くの故郷を目指しつつ、動物たちをお手伝い

zh.title: 海獭冒险开放世界《Otterly Lost》 海獭太可爱了，一开始人气就达到了100%。帮助动物，同时瞄准遥远的家乡

en.title: Sea otter adventure open world "Otterly Lost" The sea otters are so cute that it started with a 100% popularity rate. Helping animals while aiming for their distant hometown
en.summary: Soulworks Interactive released Otterly Lost on September 24th. This is a story-driven adventure game where you play as a sea otter as you explore a world rich in nature and aim to return to your hometown.

items.title: 「ムーミン」ご先祖さま＆リトルミイをデザイン♪秋の装いに活躍するバッグに新柄が登場
items.summary: 『ムーミン』の世界を繊細な刺繍で表現した、ティ・ツウ・オーによる「2wayバッグ」、「トートバッグ」、「ショルダートートバッグ」に2つの新柄が仲間入りする。各種バッグの「ダークグレー（ご先祖さま）」柄と「パープル（リトルミイ）」柄が、既存の柄とともにバッグメーカー直営通販サイト「T2O ONLINE STORE」にて取り扱い中だ。

zh.title: 以“Moomin”祖先和Little My为设计灵感♪新图案现已出现在适合秋季服装的包袋上
zh.summary: T Tzu O 的「2way bag」、「tote bag」、「shoulder tote bag」将新增两种图案，以精致的刺绣表达「Moomin」的世界。各种包袋的“深灰色（祖先）”和“紫色（小我）”图案现已与现有图案一起在包袋制造商的直邮订购网站“T2O ONLINE STORE”上出售。

en.title: Designed with "Moomin" ancestors and Little My ♪ New patterns are now available on bags that are useful for autumn outfits
en.summary: Two new patterns will be added to the ``2way bag'', ``tote bag'', and ``shoulder tote bag'' by T Tzu O, which express the world of ``Moomin'' with delicate embroidery. The ``Dark Gray (Ancestors)'' and ``Purple (Little My)'' patterns of various bags are now available at the bag manufacturer's direct mail order site ``T2O ONLINE STORE'' along with the existing patterns.

items.title: 「Suicaのペンギン」栗の形をしたお顔がキュート♪マロンケーキ、プリンなど秋スイーツが販売中【池袋・ホテルメトロポリタン】

zh.title: “Suica企鹅”有着可爱的栗子脸♪栗子蛋糕和布丁等秋季甜点正在销售[池袋/大都会酒店]

en.title: “Suica Penguin” has a cute chestnut-shaped face ♪ Autumn sweets such as marron cake and pudding are on sale [Ikebukuro/Hotel Metropolitan]

We have a ``maron cake'' with a cute Suica penguin face shaped like a chestnut, ``puddings'' and ``season cakes'' that use seasonal ingredients such as pumpkin and pear, which are the flavors of autumn.

items.title: 1300人の武将で天下統一を目指せる三国志シム『英雄立志伝：三国志』、正式リリースで日本語対応し盛況博す。史実から民間伝承までてんこ盛り、“卑弥呼でも遊べる”天下統一ライフ

items.title: 目的地なし、ひたすらドライブ没頭ゲーム『Slow Roads』Steamでさっそく好調スタート。荒野も海岸も“月面”も、ぼんやり走るZENな旅
items.summary: Topograph Interactiveは9月24日、『Slow Roads』のSteam版を配信開始した。

zh.title: 《Slow Roads》是一款没有目的地的沉浸式驾驶游戏，在 Steam 上取得了良好的开端。穿越荒野、海岸和月球的禅宗之旅。
zh.summary: Topograph Interactive 于 9 月 24 日开始发行《Slow Roads》的 Steam 版本。

en.title: ``Slow Roads'', an immersive driving game with no destination, is off to a good start on Steam. A ZEN journey through the wilderness, the coast, and the moon.
en.summary: Topograph Interactive began distributing the Steam version of "Slow Roads" on September 24th.

items.title: Steamの生みの親ゲイブ、“モンゴルの喉歌”にハマり会社で毎日歌うので「みんな迷惑してた」と元Valve社員がぶっちゃける。うるさくて、オフィスのドアを閉められる
items.summary: Gabe氏はかつて、Valveのオフィスでモンゴルの「ホーミー」などで知られる喉歌の練習を繰り返し、従業員たちは騒音を避けるためにオフィスのドアを閉めるほどだったそうだ。

zh.title: Steam 的创始人 Gabe 沉迷于“蒙古喉歌”，每天在工作时都唱这首歌，以至于一名前 Valve 员工说：“这让大家很烦。”太吵了，我不得不关上办公室的门。
zh.summary: 加布曾经在 Valve 的办公室里练习喉唱，这被称为蒙古族的“家常便饭”，以至于员工都会关上办公室的门以避免噪音。

en.title: Gabe, the creator of Steam, became addicted to ``Mongolian throat singing'' and sang it every day at work, so much so that a former Valve employee says, ``It was annoying everyone.'' It's so noisy I have to close the office door.
en.summary: Gabe once practiced throat singing, known as the Mongolian "homey", so often in Valve's offices that employees would close the office door to avoid the noise.

Can the idea of ​​slowing down the economy be implemented in reality? In this episode, Assistant Professor Huang Jingyang of the Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen) will trace the origins of the "speed-up theory", analyze the differences in the positions of various parties in the U.S. technology circle, and dismantle the current split between the two parties, the federal government, and local governments in the United States on AI regulation. en.title: ``Ansel'' forks darktable, eliminates redundant functions, and improves usability in terms of design.
